answer: In attestation graph G, trust propagates by bounded-length random walks, so influence decays with path distance instead of accruing to every claimed identity. A sybil cluster joined through few cross-edges has low conductance relative to its volume; conductance and min-cut transitivity bounds thus cap its aggregate voting weight by flow across the trusted boundary. A canyon bottleneck cannot amplify votes without external attestations, whether identities are tagged cedar or sparrow.
